summary: No blocking correctness or memory-safety findings in the frozen bounded incremental tool-call assembler. Not gateway, native SSE or M3 acceptance.
scope_note: Diff actually contains four additions: three code/test files and docs/evidence/m3-sse-tool-assembly.md. No existing production files or build wiring changed.

supplied_unit_tests.leak_accounting: baseline restored after each injected failure

independent_probes.oom_shape: delayed id/type, name fragments, Unicode, NUL and newline arguments
independent_probes.post_completion_guards: feed and repeated complete fail sticky on every API scenario; output serialized after assembler destruction

coverage: Index integer extrema, parser overflow, floats/bools/negative/out-of-range values, sparse and reverse-order 32 slots, 33-entry limit, duplicate same-chunk index.
Index reuse with identical whole ID/type allowed, changed ID rejected, ID fragments not concatenated, duplicate final IDs rejected.
Unknown/empty/delimiter/NUL object keys; strict decoder rejects duplicate and escaped-equivalent keys. Programmatically constructed NUL keys rejected by helper.
UTF8 and NUL argument bytes preserved verbatim, including non-JSON argument text; malformed programmatic UTF8 rejected; NUL ID/name rejected.
Decoded character-boundary fragment partition matrix, delayed metadata, repeated name/argument deltas retained rather than deduplicated.
Missing explicit ID/type/name/arguments rejected at completion; explicit empty arguments accepted; no fabricated success fields.
Exact ID cap, exact compact serialization cap and cap+1, exact retained-byte capacity and overflow, escaping expansion, aggregate limits in supplied unit tests.
Input mutation/free cannot alter snapshot; final snapshot survives assembler destruction; errors and finalization sticky; no partial output.
Fresh supplied 32-call allocation sweep plus independently authored delayed-metadata single-call sweep, both single-shot and persistent allocation failures.

caller_obligations: Reject duplicate JSON object keys BEFORE decoded objects collapse them.
Bound ingress including raw JSON/envelopes and transport feed work.
Keep one assembler per response choice; do not share across choices/requests or threads.
Treat IDs/type as observed whole values, names/arguments as decoded string deltas.
Call complete only after independently validated authoritative completion; validate finish reason, DONE, transport completion and envelope outside this helper.
Do not treat an assembled invocation as tool execution or success; bind executor evidence to authoritative IDs separately.
Apply downstream tool-boundary and full assistant-envelope limits; helper cap covers tool_calls array only.
Keep allocator configuration stable for all live Jansson objects.

limits: Standalone helper only; no gateway/CMake/native observer wiring, routing, bridge, transport fragmentation, provider compatibility or integration acceptance.
No full-project CTest run: isolated new helper is not registered in build files; no claim of whole-project regression proof.
Jansson shared library in existing image was not rebuilt with sanitizers; allocation hooks exercise Jansson allocations and instrumented helper ownership paths.
No performance, stack-pressure or concurrency benchmarks. Bounded retained data does not itself bound caller feed count; header explicitly delegates bounded ingress.
Decoder duplicate-key tests prove strict probe decoder behavior, not any future SSE decoder.
The author evidence describes historical TDD red/green steps; this review independently reran the frozen result, not those historical steps.

review_harness_issue.description: First independent run expected four wire NUL-key cases to reach helper, but Jansson rejects NUL keys during decoding even with JSON_ALLOW_NUL. Corrected expectations to decoder rejection and added two programmatic NUL-key helper cases; no production changes. Original failed command/results preserved below.
